eecs427:l10_p04_b.caption: To write, drive one bitline low and raise the wordline; the access device must overpower the PMOS pull-up so A_b falls and the cell flips.
eecs427:l10_p04_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p05_t.name: l10_p05_t
eecs427:l10_p05_t.caption: The A_b voltage during write rises with the pull-up ratio, so the PMOS must be weak relative to the access NMOS.
eecs427:l10_p05_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p06_t.name: l10_p06_t
eecs427:l10_p06_t.caption: A textbook 6T cell is 26 by 45 lambda; tiles mirror to share VDD, GND and bitline contacts.
eecs427:l10_p06_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p06_b.name: l10_p06_b
eecs427:l10_p06_b.caption: Thin-cell layout keeps poly and diffusion straight and in one direction, and also shortens the bitlines.
eecs427:l10_p06_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p07_t.name: l10_p07_t
eecs427:l10_p07_t.caption: Five Intel generations show steady cell-area scaling, with the switch to the thin cell at 65 nm.
eecs427:l10_p07_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p07_b.name: l10_p07_b
eecs427:l10_p07_b.caption: A published 65 nm cell uses pull-down 130/65, pull-up 115/65 and access 100/75 nm, about 1 µm² at 90 nm and 0.25 µm² at 45 nm.
eecs427:l10_p07_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p08_t.name: l10_p08_t
eecs427:l10_p08_t.caption: At low VDD the 6T cell degrades, so read and write assists or a different bitcell are needed.
eecs427:l10_p08_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p08_b.name: l10_p08_b
eecs427:l10_p08_b.caption: Leakage is cut by lowering cell VDD, raising cell GND, sleep transistors, lowering Vgs or Vds of the access paths, or reverse body bias.
eecs427:l10_p08_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p09_t.name: l10_p09_t
eecs427:l10_p09_t.caption: The 8T cell adds a separate read port (RWL, RBL) so reads never disturb the storage nodes, at about 30% area cost.
eecs427:l10_p09_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p09_b.name: l10_p09_b
eecs427:l10_p09_b.caption: The 10T subthreshold cell adds a read buffer that cuts bitline leakage and works down to 380 mV at 65 nm.
eecs427:l10_p09_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p10_t.name: l10_p10_t
eecs427:l10_p10_t.caption: Each column needs bitline conditioning, sense amplifiers and column multiplexing.
eecs427:l10_p10_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p10_b.name: l10_p10_b
eecs427:l10_p10_b.caption: PMOS devices precharge both bitlines high before a read, and an equalizer shorts them so the sense amp starts from zero differential.
eecs427:l10_p10_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p11_t.name: l10_p11_t
eecs427:l10_p11_t.caption: With 128 cells on a bitline, a big C discharged by a small cell current is slow, so sense amps fire on a small swing.
eecs427:l10_p11_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p11_b.name: l10_p11_b
eecs427:l10_p11_b.caption: A clocked latch-type sense amp fires after enough swing develops, with isolation devices cutting off the bitline capacitance.
eecs427:l10_p11_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p12_t.name: l10_p12_t
eecs427:l10_p12_t.caption: A 2k-word × 16-bit memory folded into 256 rows × 128 columns needs sixteen 8:1 column muxes.
eecs427:l10_p12_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p12_b.name: l10_p12_b
eecs427:l10_p12_b.caption: Hierarchical blocks shorten wires and let the block address activate only one block.
eecs427:l10_p12_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l10_p13_t.name: l10_p13_t
eecs427:l10_p13_t.caption: Column muxes can be NMOS pass-transistor trees with precharged outputs, decoded directly by A0 to A2.
eecs427:l10_p13_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p01_b.name: l11_p01_b
eecs427:l11_p01_b.caption: A synchronous path is launch register R1, combinational logic, and capture register R2, all on one clock.
eecs427:l11_p01_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p02_t.name: l11_p02_t
eecs427:l11_p02_t.caption: Setup and hold bracket a window around the clock edge where D must be stable; tc-q is measured from the edge to Q.
eecs427:l11_p02_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p02_b.name: l11_p02_b
eecs427:l11_p02_b.caption: With ideal clocks the cycle must cover tc-q + logic + tsu, and the fastest path must outlast thold.
eecs427:l11_p02_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p03_t.name: l11_p03_t
eecs427:l11_p03_t.caption: Skew is spatial variation of the same edge across the chip; jitter is temporal variation of successive edges at one point.
eecs427:l11_p03_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p03_b.name: l11_p03_b
eecs427:l11_p03_b.caption: Both skew and jitter eat into the usable cycle time.
eecs427:l11_p03_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p04_t.name: l11_p04_t
eecs427:l11_p04_t.caption: Clock uncertainty comes from the generator, devices, supply, interconnect, temperature, load, and coupling.
eecs427:l11_p04_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p04_b.name: l11_p04_b
eecs427:l11_p04_b.caption: Measured skew across an IBM processor's paths spans tens of picoseconds around the nominal arrival.
eecs427:l11_p04_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p05_t.name: l11_p05_t
eecs427:l11_p05_t.caption: Clock routed with the data gives positive skew; clock routed against the data gives negative skew.
eecs427:l11_p05_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p05_b.name: l11_p05_b
eecs427:l11_p05_b.caption: Positive skew gives the logic extra time but makes hold harder, and slowing the clock cannot fix a hold violation.
eecs427:l11_p05_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p06_t.name: l11_p06_t
eecs427:l11_p06_t.caption: Negative skew shortens the effective cycle but relaxes hold.
eecs427:l11_p06_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p06_b.name: l11_p06_b
eecs427:l11_p06_b.caption: Setup with skew: T ≥ tc-q + tsu + tlogic − δ, worst when the receiving edge comes early.
eecs427:l11_p06_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p07_t.name: l11_p07_t
eecs427:l11_p07_t.caption: Hold with skew: tc-q,cd + tlogic,cd > thold + δ, worst when the receiving edge comes late.
eecs427:l11_p07_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p07_b.name: l11_p07_b
eecs427:l11_p07_b.caption: A good flop needs small tc-q, tsu and thold, low clock load and power, drive strength, scan, and robustness.
eecs427:l11_p07_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p08_t.name: l11_p08_t
eecs427:l11_p08_t.caption: Buffer the input, never float storage nodes, give them modest capacitance, and keep their wires short.
eecs427:l11_p08_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p08_b.name: l11_p08_b
eecs427:l11_p08_b.caption: The C²MOS dynamic register uses clocked inverters for master and slave, with storage on C1 and C2.
eecs427:l11_p08_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p09_t.name: l11_p09_t
eecs427:l11_p09_t.caption: TSPC latches use a single clock with no inverted phase: the negative latch holds at clk=1, the positive latch is transparent at clk=1.
eecs427:l11_p09_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p09_b.name: l11_p09_b
eecs427:l11_p09_b.caption: An edge-triggered cell can be two latches in master–slave form or one latch opened by a short pulse.
eecs427:l11_p09_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p10_t.name: l11_p10_t
eecs427:l11_p10_t.caption: A glitch generator ANDs CLK with a delayed inverted CLK to make a short CLKG pulse that opens a single C²MOS-style latch.
eecs427:l11_p10_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p10_b.name: l11_p10_b
eecs427:l11_p10_b.caption: The HLFF used in AMD K6 and K7 merges a pulse window and a latch in one cell.
eecs427:l11_p10_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l11_p11_t.name: l11_p11_t
eecs427:l11_p11_t.caption: Clocks are not ideal, skew should stay under about 10% of the period, and sequentials consume much of the timing and power budget.
eecs427:l11_p11_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p01_b.name: l12_p01_b
eecs427:l12_p01_b.caption: Adding k words with k−1 ordinary adders is large and slow because every adder propagates a carry.
eecs427:l12_p01_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p02_t.name: l12_p02_t
eecs427:l12_p02_t.caption: A carry-save adder is N independent full adders that reduce three words to a sum word and a carry word.
eecs427:l12_p02_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p02_b.name: l12_p02_b
eecs427:l12_p02_b.caption: Use k−2 CSA stages to keep the sum in redundant carry-save form, then one carry-propagate adder at the end.
eecs427:l12_p02_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p03_t.name: l12_p03_t
eecs427:l12_p03_t.caption: An M×N multiply forms N shifted M-bit partial products and sums them into an M+N-bit product.
eecs427:l12_p03_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p03_b.name: l12_p03_b
eecs427:l12_p03_b.caption: The product is a double sum of AND terms xi·yj weighted by 2^(i+j).
eecs427:l12_p03_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p04_t.name: l12_p04_t
eecs427:l12_p04_t.caption: A dot diagram shows every partial-product bit as a dot, making the parallelogram shape of the sum visible.
eecs427:l12_p04_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p04_b.name: l12_p04_b
eecs427:l12_p04_b.caption: An array multiplier sums partial products with rows of carry-save adders and finishes with a carry-propagate adder.
eecs427:l12_p04_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p05_t.name: l12_p05_t
eecs427:l12_p05_t.caption: The array can be squashed into a rectangular floorplan for regular layout.
eecs427:l12_p05_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p06_t.name: l12_p06_t
eecs427:l12_p06_t.caption: Radix-2^r encoding looks at r multiplier bits at a time, cutting the number of partial products to N/r.
eecs427:l12_p06_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p06_b.name: l12_p06_b
eecs427:l12_p06_b.caption: Booth encoding replaces 3Y with −Y plus 4Y in the next partial product, so only 0, ±Y and ±2Y are needed.
eecs427:l12_p06_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p07_t.name: l12_p07_t
eecs427:l12_p07_t.caption: A Booth encoder produces SINGLE, DOUBLE and NEG per partial product, and a selector per bit chooses and inverts.
eecs427:l12_p07_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p07_b.name: l12_p07_b
eecs427:l12_p07_b.caption: Negative partial products need sign extension, which adds many bits and puts a heavy load on each sign bit.
eecs427:l12_p07_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p08_t.name: l12_p08_t
eecs427:l12_p08_t.caption: Because the sign field is all 0s or all 1s, it can be replaced by all 1s plus a correction in one column.
eecs427:l12_p08_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p08_b.name: l12_p08_b
eecs427:l12_p08_b.caption: All the constant 1s can be summed at design time, leaving only a few sign-related bits per partial product.
eecs427:l12_p08_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p09_t.name: l12_p09_t
eecs427:l12_p09_t.caption: A Wallace tree reduces partial products with full and half adders in parallel layers, cutting the height by 3:2 per level.
eecs427:l12_p09_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p09_b.name: l12_p09_b
eecs427:l12_p09_b.caption: In the 4×4 Wallace tree the critical path is only two adder stages before the final adder.
eecs427:l12_p09_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p10_t.name: l12_p10_t
eecs427:l12_p10_t.caption: A 4:2 compressor built from two full adders reduces four bits to two with a lateral carry that does not ripple.
eecs427:l12_p10_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l12_p10_b.name: l12_p10_b
eecs427:l12_p10_b.caption: The final adder sees partial-product bits arriving at different times, with the middle columns latest.
eecs427:l12_p10_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p01_b.name: l13_p01_b
eecs427:l13_p01_b.caption: Pitch = w + s and aspect ratio t/w ≈ 2 in modern processes, packing many tall, skinny wires.
eecs427:l13_p01_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p02_t.name: l13_p02_t
eecs427:l13_p02_t.caption: Modern stacks have 6–10+ layers: thin dense M1 for cells, wider mid layers, thickest top layers for VDD, GND and clock.
eecs427:l13_p02_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p03_t.name: l13_p03_t
eecs427:l13_p03_t.caption: A distributed wire is approximated by N lumped segments; the π-model is preferred and the L-model overestimates delay.
eecs427:l13_p03_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p03_b.name: l13_p03_b
eecs427:l13_p03_b.caption: R = ρl/(tw) = R□·(l/w): count squares, since a square of any size has the same resistance.
eecs427:l13_p03_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p04_t.name: l13_p04_t
eecs427:l13_p04_t.caption: Aluminum until the 180 nm generation, copper since; Cu 1.7 vs Al 2.8 µΩ·cm bulk resistivity.
eecs427:l13_p04_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p04_b.name: l13_p04_b
eecs427:l13_p04_b.caption: Contacts and vias are 2–20 Ω each, so use many in parallel for low resistance.
eecs427:l13_p04_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p05_t.name: l13_p05_t
eecs427:l13_p05_t.caption: Ctotal = Ctop + Cbot + 2·Cadj: plates above and below plus both neighbors.
eecs427:l13_p05_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p05_b.name: l13_p05_b
eecs427:l13_p05_b.caption: C grows with overlap area (w, t) and shrinks with distance (s, h); k = 3.9 for SiO2, about 3 or less for low-k.
eecs427:l13_p05_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p06_t.name: l13_p06_t
eecs427:l13_p06_t.caption: Diffusion is 1–2 fF/µm and resistive and poly is highly resistive: never use them as wires.
eecs427:l13_p06_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p06_b.name: l13_p06_b
eecs427:l13_p06_b.caption: Capacitive coupling to a switching neighbor injects noise into quiet wires and changes delay of switching ones.
eecs427:l13_p06_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p07_t.name: l13_p07_t
eecs427:l13_p07_t.caption: Effective coupling capacitance depends on the neighbor: Miller factor 1 if quiet, 0 if switching the same way, 2 if switching opposite.
eecs427:l13_p07_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p07_b.name: l13_p07_b
eecs427:l13_p07_b.caption: A floating victim sees ΔVvictim = Cadj/(Cgnd−v + Cadj)·ΔVaggressor — a capacitive divider.
eecs427:l13_p07_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p08_t.name: l13_p08_t
eecs427:l13_p08_t.caption: A driven victim fights back: noise is divided by (1 + k), where k is the ratio of aggressor to victim time constants.
eecs427:l13_p08_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p08_b.name: l13_p08_b
eecs427:l13_p08_b.caption: For Cadj = Cvictim the floating victim reaches 50%, while victims with half-, equal- and double-size drivers peak at 16%, 8% and 4%.
eecs427:l13_p08_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p09_t.name: l13_p09_t
eecs427:l13_p09_t.caption: Noise below the noise margin is harmless to static CMOS, but glitches cost delay and power, and dynamic logic and memories can fail outright.
eecs427:l13_p09_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p09_b.name: l13_p09_b
eecs427:l13_p09_b.caption: Wire engineering trades width, spacing, layer and shielding: wider pitch lowers both RC/2 delay and the coupling fraction.
eecs427:l13_p09_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p10_t.name: l13_p10_t
eecs427:l13_p10_t.caption: RC delay grows as l², so break long wires into N segments, each driven by an inverter or buffer.
eecs427:l13_p10_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p10_b.name: l13_p10_b
eecs427:l13_p10_b.caption: Each segment is modeled as an inverter of width W (R/W, CW·pinv) driving a π-model wire of length l/N and the next repeater's gate CW.
eecs427:l13_p10_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p11_t.name: l13_p11_t
eecs427:l13_p11_t.caption: Minimizing Elmore delay gives segment length l/N = √(2RC′/(RwCw)) and width W = √(RCw/(RwC′)), with C′ = C(1 + pinv).
eecs427:l13_p11_t.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs427:l13_p11_b.name: l13_p11_b
eecs427:l13_p11_b.caption: Delay-optimal repeaters cost 1.87·Cw·VDD² per length, an 87% premium; downsizing for minimum EDP cuts the premium to 30% for 14% more delay.
eecs427:l13_p11_b.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p005.name: m01_p005
eecs627:m01_p005.caption: A quiet victim coupled to a switching aggressor sees four glitch types, low/high undershoot and low/high overshoot, depending on its own state and the aggressor direction.
eecs627:m01_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p006.name: m01_p006
eecs627:m01_p006.caption: The distributed RC aggressor/victim pair reduces to a Thevenin aggressor source, the victim holding resistance Rh, the victim ground cap Cg and the coupling cap Cc.
eecs627:m01_p006.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p007.name: m01_p007
eecs627:m01_p007.caption: Ignoring the holder during a fast edge gives the charge-divider bound ΔVN = ΔVa·Cc/(Cg+Cc).
eecs627:m01_p007.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p008.name: m01_p008
eecs627:m01_p008.caption: A stronger victim driver, weaker aggressor, larger Cg or smaller Cc all lower the peak noise, and each one changes the waveform's rise or fall differently.
eecs627:m01_p008.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p014.name: m01_p014
eecs627:m01_p014.caption: When a dynamic node shares charge with an internal stack node, Vo = Vdd·Co/(Co+Ci), unless the internal node clamps at Vdd − Vt first.
eecs627:m01_p014.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p016.name: m01_p016
eecs627:m01_p016.caption: Ground and supply networks carry current, so the driver's and receiver's local rails differ, and a receiver can see a "0" that turns its NMOS on.
eecs627:m01_p016.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p018.name: m01_p018
eecs627:m01_p018.caption: When undershoot noise drives a source below ground, the n+/p-sub diode forward-biases and injects electrons, which diffuse to the nearest high-voltage n+ node, such as a dynamic node at Vdd.
eecs627:m01_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p019.name: m01_p019
eecs627:m01_p019.caption: A Vdd-tied n+ guard ring around sensitive NMOS collects the stray electrons, and it also helps with latch-up.
eecs627:m01_p019.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p021.name: m01_p021
eecs627:m01_p021.caption: Alpha particles and neutrons leave an ionization track, and the charge collected from that track is a localized, angle-dependent, non-deterministic event.
eecs627:m01_p021.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p023.name: m01_p023
eecs627:m01_p023.caption: A node flips when the collected charge exceeds Qcrit ≈ Cnode·VDD, and the failure rate is the tail of the strike-charge distribution beyond Qcrit.
eecs627:m01_p023.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p025.name: m01_p025
eecs627:m01_p025.caption: FIT counts failures per 10⁹ device-hours, so 1000 FIT is about 1 failure per 100 years per chip but about 1 per month across 1200 machines.
eecs627:m01_p025.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p028.name: m01_p028
eecs627:m01_p028.caption: In FinFET nodes per-bit SRAM SER drops, but multi-cell upsets dominate, and unprotected flip-flops now cause about 50% of system FIT.
eecs627:m01_p028.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p030.name: m01_p030
eecs627:m01_p030.caption: A normal latch keeps its state on two nodes, so after a strike makes both N0 and N1 high, the original state cannot be recovered.
eecs627:m01_p030.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p031.name: m01_p031
eecs627:m01_p031.caption: Triple modular redundancy stores the bit in three flops and a majority voter outputs the value held by at least two of them.
eecs627:m01_p031.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p032.name: m01_p032
eecs627:m01_p032.caption: The DICE latch stores the bit on four nodes (N0a, N1a, N0b, N1b), each driven by a PMOS gated by one neighbor and an NMOS gated by the other.
eecs627:m01_p032.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p033.name: m01_p033
eecs627:m01_p033.caption: After a strike on one DICE node, two neighbors float and one is held at ½, so the two untouched nodes drive the struck node back to its original value.
eecs627:m01_p033.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p036.name: m01_p036
eecs627:m01_p036.caption: Data noise flips a latch only if it lands inside the setup-hold window around the closing clock edge.
eecs627:m01_p036.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p039.name: m01_p039
eecs627:m01_p039.caption: An unbuffered latch input on a long wire is vulnerable to low undershoot, because a below-ground D turns on the off transmission gate and corrupts the stored node.
eecs627:m01_p039.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p040.name: m01_p040
eecs627:m01_p040.caption: A dynamic gate is exposed for the whole evaluate window and is sensitive to low overshoot on its inputs, because a glitch that discharges the precharged node cannot be undone.
eecs627:m01_p040.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p043.name: m01_p043
eecs627:m01_p043.caption: Aggressor noise only matters if its propagation window lines up with the capture flop's setup-hold window, so in this example only A1 can cause a failure.
eecs627:m01_p043.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p045.name: m01_p045
eecs627:m01_p045.caption: Injected noise has to be propagated until it hits a latch, and along the way each gate may attenuate it, amplify it or add new coupled noise.
eecs627:m01_p045.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p049.name: m01_p049
eecs627:m01_p049.caption: Model a long inverter chain as a feedback loop, where VIL/VIH define valid inputs and NML = VIL − VOL and NMH = VOH − VIH bound the DC noise allowed per stage.
eecs627:m01_p049.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p053.name: m01_p053
eecs627:m01_p053.caption: Choosing VIL = VIH at the 45° crossing gives the degenerate case NML = NMH = 0, so pushing one margin up always takes from the other.
eecs627:m01_p053.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p056.name: m01_p056
eecs627:m01_p056.caption: Each stage's noise gain is ∂Vo/∂Vx = k/(1−k), so a stage stays non-amplifying only where the inverter's small-signal gain k ≤ ½.
eecs627:m01_p056.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p060.name: m01_p060
eecs627:m01_p060.caption: An aggressor switching opposite to the victim during the victim's transition adds a glitch that slows the edge, which makes setup timing worse.
eecs627:m01_p060.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p061.name: m01_p061
eecs627:m01_p061.caption: An aggressor switching the same way speeds the victim edge, which reduces delay and can break hold timing.
eecs627:m01_p061.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p069.name: m01_p069
eecs627:m01_p069.caption: With equal slews and opposite switching, replacing Cc by 2·Cc to ground (4 + 2·2 = 8 fF on each net) reproduces the full coupled simulation.
eecs627:m01_p069.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p071.name: m01_p071
eecs627:m01_p071.caption: With a 4× faster aggressor and 4 fF coupling, the matching grounded caps are 24 fF on the victim and 9 fF on the aggressor, which shows how asymmetric Miller factors become.
eecs627:m01_p071.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p074.name: m01_p074
eecs627:m01_p074.caption: Spacing cuts both Cc and total cap at an area cost, and shielding eliminates Cc but increases total capacitance.
eecs627:m01_p074.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m01_p075.name: m01_p075
eecs627:m01_p075.caption: Upper metals are wider and more widely spaced (Cc ≈ 0.1Cg), lower metals are dense (Cc ≈ 2Cg), and bus encoding reduces worst-case transitions.
eecs627:m01_p075.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p005.name: m02_p005
eecs627:m02_p005.caption: Deciding which of two nearly simultaneous events came first takes longer the closer they are, and fails when it takes longer than the time allotted.
eecs627:m02_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p007.name: m02_p007
eecs627:m02_p007.caption: A latch has two stable states and one metastable balance point where A = B = Vm.
eecs627:m02_p007.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p009.name: m02_p009
eecs627:m02_p009.caption: The initial imbalance ΔV0 is proportional to the input/clock offset Δt, scaled by the aperture window ta.
eecs627:m02_p009.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p010.name: m02_p010
eecs627:m02_p010.caption: Once the inputs settle, the latch is two cross-coupled inverters and ΔV grows exponentially with time constant τr = Cd/gm.
eecs627:m02_p010.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p011.name: m02_p011
eecs627:m02_p011.caption: Setting ΔV(td) = 1 V gives td = τr·ln(ta/Δt), so td goes to infinity as Δt goes to 0.
eecs627:m02_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p013.name: m02_p013
eecs627:m02_p013.caption: For a given allotted td, the synchronizer fails only if the two edges fall within ta·e^(−td/τr) of each other.
eecs627:m02_p013.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p014.name: m02_p014
eecs627:m02_p014.caption: Failure frequency is ta·fA·fB·e^(−td/τr) and MTBF is its reciprocal.
eecs627:m02_p014.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p015.name: m02_p015
eecs627:m02_p015.caption: With ta = 100 ps, τr = 200 ps and td = 10 ns, MTBF comes out near 10^8 years.
eecs627:m02_p015.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p018.name: m02_p018
eecs627:m02_p018.caption: Moving logic out of the crossing cycle raises td from TA − tlogic − tsu to TA − tsu.
eecs627:m02_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p019.name: m02_p019
eecs627:m02_p019.caption: A third stage multiplies two independent failure probabilities, so the exponent effectively doubles.
eecs627:m02_p019.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p020.name: m02_p020
eecs627:m02_p020.caption: Never synchronize the same asynchronous signal in more than one place, because the copies can resolve differently.
eecs627:m02_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p021.name: m02_p021
eecs627:m02_p021.caption: Synchronizing each bit of a bus separately lets skew put different bits into different cycles.
eecs627:m02_p021.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p022.name: m02_p022
eecs627:m02_p022.caption: Handshaking synchronizes one REQ/ACK pair instead of the data bus, so the multi-bit data is stable when it is read.
eecs627:m02_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p024.name: m02_p024
eecs627:m02_p024.caption: Smaller cap, waiting longer, lower frequency, faster gates, completion logic and more stages all reduce failure frequency.
eecs627:m02_p024.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p025.name: m02_p025
eecs627:m02_p025.caption: Skewed inverters detect a mid-rail value and hold en low, but en can itself go metastable.
eecs627:m02_p025.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p027.name: m02_p027
eecs627:m02_p027.caption: A Jamb latch resolves faster because its feedback reduces to a lightly loaded cross-coupled inverter pair.
eecs627:m02_p027.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p028.name: m02_p028
eecs627:m02_p028.caption: The dynamic synchronizer uses precharged dynamic buffers whose skewed inverters turn an intermediate voltage into a pulse that resolves cleanly.
eecs627:m02_p028.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m02_p030.name: m02_p030
eecs627:m02_p030.caption: Adding capacitance stretches τ until the metastability window is measurable, then the line is extrapolated back to the self-load.
eecs627:m02_p030.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p004.name: m03_p004
eecs627:m03_p004.caption: Short-circuit current flows only while both devices conduct, so a slow input driving a fast output is the bad case.
eecs627:m03_p004.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p005.name: m03_p005
eecs627:m03_p005.caption: On a rising output the supply delivers C·VDD², half burned in the PMOS and half stored on the load.
eecs627:m03_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p006.name: m03_p006
eecs627:m03_p006.caption: On the falling edge the supply delivers nothing, and the NMOS dissipates the ½CV² stored on the load.
eecs627:m03_p006.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p007.name: m03_p007
eecs627:m03_p007.caption: Switching power is α·C·VDD²·f, with α = 1 for a clock and ½ for a signal that switches once per cycle.
eecs627:m03_p007.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p011.name: m03_p011
eecs627:m03_p011.caption: Gating 90% of the flip-flops in an MPEG4 decoder cut power from 30.6 mW to 8.5 mW, about 70%, using a latch-based glitch-free gate.
eecs627:m03_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p014.name: m03_p014
eecs627:m03_p014.caption: Two parallel copies at fref/2 each get twice the time, so VDD can drop and power scales by about ε², because the (2+ov)/2 factor is almost 1.
eecs627:m03_p014.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p015.name: m03_p015
eecs627:m03_p015.caption: Pipelining halves the logic depth per stage, so VDD can drop at the same clock: with ov = 10% and ε = 0.66, power is 0.48·Pref.
eecs627:m03_p015.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p017.name: m03_p017
eecs627:m03_p017.caption: In clustered voltage scaling only non-critical gates move to VDDL, and paths may go from high to low voltage only, with level-shifting flops at the boundary.
eecs627:m03_p017.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p018.name: m03_p018
eecs627:m03_p018.caption: Single-rail cells at VDDH and VDDL need N-well isolation, so they go in dedicated rows or dedicated regions.
eecs627:m03_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p019.name: m03_p019
eecs627:m03_p019.caption: With a shared N-well tied to VDDH, VDDL cells mix freely in a row, but their PMOS sees reverse body bias VSB = VDDL − VDDH.
eecs627:m03_p019.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p020.name: m03_p020
eecs627:m03_p020.caption: A VDDL input cannot turn off a VDDH PMOS, so the level-converting flip-flop restores full VDDH swing inside the flop.
eecs627:m03_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p022.name: m03_p022
eecs627:m03_p022.caption: For a task needing only part of peak throughput, clock or power gating saves energy linearly with duty cycle, while just-in-time DVS saves roughly with its cube.
eecs627:m03_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p024.name: m03_p024
eecs627:m03_p024.caption: Lowering VDD cuts active energy quadratically, but below threshold the exponential delay makes leakage energy explode, so total energy has a minimum at Vmin.
eecs627:m03_p024.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p026.name: m03_p026
eecs627:m03_p026.caption: At low voltage, delay sensitivity to VDD, Vth and temperature grows exponentially, as the 65 nm inverter-chain variability plot shows.
eecs627:m03_p026.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p027.name: m03_p027
eecs627:m03_p027.caption: Near-threshold computing backs off from Vmin: about 2× the minimum energy buys about 100× less delay than subthreshold, while staying about 10× below superthreshold energy.
eecs627:m03_p027.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p029.name: m03_p029
eecs627:m03_p029.caption: In a DCVS converter the VDDL-driven NMOS must overpower the cross-coupled VDDH PMOS (IN-ON > IP-ON) while the PMOS must beat NMOS leakage (IP-ON > IN-OFF), and both margins collapse as VDDL drops.
eecs627:m03_p029.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p030.name: m03_p030
eecs627:m03_p030.caption: The pass-gate converter reduces contention because the fighting PMOS M3 loses VGS as IN rises and M1's VDS collapses once IN is high.
eecs627:m03_p030.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p031.name: m03_p031
eecs627:m03_p031.caption: Splitting the keeper into series devices (STR1) or driving it from an inverter (STR2) weakens contention without the extra node-N load of a long-channel keeper.
eecs627:m03_p031.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p032.name: m03_p032
eecs627:m03_p032.caption: For VDDL = 0.3 V to VDDH = 2.5 V, zero-Vth thick-oxide devices shield the thin-oxide inputs, but plain DCVS yields only 64.72% in 100,000 Monte Carlo runs.
eecs627:m03_p032.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p033.name: m03_p033
eecs627:m03_p033.caption: Interrupting the DCVS PMOS path weakens it, but the fight is still 0.3 V of NMOS VGS against 2.2 V of PMOS VSG, and yield only reaches 73.77%.
eecs627:m03_p033.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p034.name: m03_p034
eecs627:m03_p034.caption: The split-control converter adds diodes so the weak NMOS pulls down a node behind off diodes and turns on the opposite PMOS, raising yield to 98.93%.
eecs627:m03_p034.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m03_p035.name: m03_p035
eecs627:m03_p035.caption: In the SLC the output buffer runs super-threshold in one state and fully off in the other, but the scheme requires VDDH ≫ 2VD.
eecs627:m03_p035.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p003.name: m04_p003
eecs627:m04_p003.caption: The supply network must look like a low impedance at every frequency of interest, and Z ≤ r·VDD²/P gives about 1 mΩ for a 100 W, 1 V chip with 10% ripple.
eecs627:m04_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p006.name: m04_p006
eecs627:m04_p006.caption: Electrically, the regulator feeds the chip through board, package and bump/bond R and L, with bulk, ceramic, package and on-chip capacitors along the way, each with its own parasitic R and L.
eecs627:m04_p006.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p008.name: m04_p008
eecs627:m04_p008.caption: IR drop scales with current (15× from low-end to high-performance), but L·di/dt scales with both current and edge rate (225×).
eecs627:m04_p008.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p009.name: m04_p009
eecs627:m04_p009.caption: IR and L·di/dt drops peak at different times and places, so they do not simply add, and fast mode changes (20 A to 100 A) excite the inductive drop.
eecs627:m04_p009.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p010.name: m04_p010
eecs627:m04_p010.caption: A sustained supply drop slows every gate, and AC supply noise acts like a noise pulse that can ring, overshoot and undershoot.
eecs627:m04_p010.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p011.name: m04_p011
eecs627:m04_p011.caption: Inductive overshoot adds oxide stress (TDDB) and limits VDD, while high current densities drive electromigration that breaks the metal.
eecs627:m04_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p015.name: m04_p015
eecs627:m04_p015.caption: A real capacitor has series L, so its impedance falls only until the LC resonance and rises again above it, which makes a capacitor useless at high frequency.
eecs627:m04_p015.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p016.name: m04_p016
eecs627:m04_p016.caption: Large board caps with ~100 pH, package caps with ~10 pH and on-chip decap behind ~1 pH C4 inductance each cover their own band, and together they flatten the impedance.
eecs627:m04_p016.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p020.name: m04_p020
eecs627:m04_p020.caption: Wire bonds are cheap but carry ~5 nH and ~200 pads, while flip-chip area arrays bring ~0.1 nH per bump and ~1000 pads spread over the die.
eecs627:m04_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p022.name: m04_p022
eecs627:m04_p022.caption: Package IR drop is non-uniform across the C4 bumps and hard to predict, as the bump-current map shows.
eecs627:m04_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p029.name: m04_p029
eecs627:m04_p029.caption: A full grid has lots of metal, lower resistance and current density, lines up with C4 bumps and is highly redundant, at the cost of metal layers and routing resources.
eecs627:m04_p029.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p030.name: m04_p030
eecs627:m04_p030.caption: Power enters through C4 balls into fully dense top metal layers, then strapped stripes and via stacks carry it down to the M2 standard-cell rails.
eecs627:m04_p030.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p036.name: m04_p036
eecs627:m04_p036.caption: Every idle gate places its device and wire capacitances between VDD and GND, and averaged over both states Ceff ≈ ½(Cgs + Cdb + Cw) + Cgd.
eecs627:m04_p036.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p037.name: m04_p037
eecs627:m04_p037.caption: Back of the envelope: implicit decap is about half of the non-switching capacitance, which with s ≈ 0.1 is much larger than the switching capacitance.
eecs627:m04_p037.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p038.name: m04_p038
eecs627:m04_p038.caption: A single thin-oxide MOS decap can short and leaks, while two stacked caps short only on a double failure and see half the voltage, at the cost of less total capacitance.
eecs627:m04_p038.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p039.name: m04_p039
eecs627:m04_p039.caption: Gating the decap through a self-biased series PMOS (or a fuse) turns it off if its oxide fails, and the self-gated version needs Isub,p > Igate,n to start up.
eecs627:m04_p039.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p042.name: m04_p042
eecs627:m04_p042.caption: An active decap switches two C/2 capacitors from parallel to series during a droop, delivering ΔQ = C(Vdd + ΔV)/2 instead of a passive cap's ΔV·C.
eecs627:m04_p042.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p047.name: m04_p047
eecs627:m04_p047.caption: A lumped L–R feeding on-chip C gives an IR step plus a damped ring at ωr = 1/√(LC), with the peak drop a quarter period after the current step.
eecs627:m04_p047.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p048.name: m04_p048
eecs627:m04_p048.caption: IR drop needs more metal, L·di/dt needs decap (which helps only as √(1/C)) or a slow ramp, and resonance needs lower Q.
eecs627:m04_p048.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p049.name: m04_p049
eecs627:m04_p049.caption: Every fix trades something: more metal lowers IR but raises Q, less L raises ωr and lowers Q, more C helps only as √C at an area cost, and slow turn-on lowers ΔI.
eecs627:m04_p049.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p050.name: m04_p050
eecs627:m04_p050.caption: The Pentium 4 supply impedance peaks near 100 MHz from package L, and a current step produces first, second and third droops from on-chip, package and board capacitance.
eecs627:m04_p050.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m04_p052.name: m04_p052
eecs627:m04_p052.caption: Measured on the package power plane of a 400 MHz design, switching from NOP to a high-power instruction produces a 160 mV maximum undershoot.
eecs627:m04_p052.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p003.name: m05_p003
eecs627:m05_p003.caption: A thin Si film (PD ~150 nm, FD <50 nm) sits on a ~400 nm buried oxide over a ~700 um handle wafer.
eecs627:m05_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p004.name: m05_p004
eecs627:m05_p004.caption: SOI removes S/D junction cap and junction leakage, is rad-hard and latch-up free, but PD-SOI has a floating body.
eecs627:m05_p004.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p009.name: m05_p009
eecs627:m05_p009.caption: Smart Cut splits a hydrogen-implanted wafer at the implant plane so the donor wafer can be reused, which made SOI cheap enough for mainstream use.
eecs627:m05_p009.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p011.name: m05_p011
eecs627:m05_p011.caption: Capacitive coupling through Cgb, Csb and Cdb changes the floating body voltage instantly on every transition.
eecs627:m05_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p012.name: m05_p012
eecs627:m05_p012.caption: DC currents (diode, leakage, tunneling, impact ionization) set the body voltage slowly, from ns to ms time constants.
eecs627:m05_p012.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p013.name: m05_p013
eecs627:m05_p013.caption: Impact ionization near the drain injects holes into an NMOS body during transitions, worst at Vgs ~ Vdd/2 and Vds = Vdd.
eecs627:m05_p013.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p014.name: m05_p014
eecs627:m05_p014.caption: At DC the body settles where charge in (DB leakage, impact ionization) balances charge out (BS forward diode).
eecs627:m05_p014.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p016.name: m05_p016
eecs627:m05_p016.caption: First switching follows a long idle period; second switching follows a recent transition, and their delays differ.
eecs627:m05_p016.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p017.name: m05_p017
eecs627:m05_p017.caption: First switch of an NMOS: body starts at 0.35 V, Cgb couples it up, Cdb couples it down 0.45 V, ending at -0.1 V.
eecs627:m05_p017.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p018.name: m05_p018
eecs627:m05_p018.caption: Second switch: the body starts at 0 V and is coupled up 0.45 V by Cgb and Cdb, so the second transition is faster than the first.
eecs627:m05_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p020.name: m05_p020
eecs627:m05_p020.caption: With source and drain both high the body floats up; pulling the source low turns on the lateral n-p-n bipolar regardless of the gate.
eecs627:m05_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p022.name: m05_p022
eecs627:m05_p022.caption: FD-SOI (<50 nm film) fully depletes, removing the bipolar and most hysteresis and giving ~70 mV/dec swing.
eecs627:m05_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p023.name: m05_p023
eecs627:m05_p023.caption: UTBB-SOI (7 nm body, 25 nm BOX, ST 28/22 nm) adds a strong back-bias knob and an undoped channel with low RDF.
eecs627:m05_p023.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p025.name: m05_p025
eecs627:m05_p025.caption: Tying the body to ground makes a 4-terminal device: slower than bulk, but no delay variation and no bipolar.
eecs627:m05_p025.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p026.name: m05_p026
eecs627:m05_p026.caption: Delay vs. Leff: floating-body SOI is fastest, bulk is next, and body-tied SOI is slowest.
eecs627:m05_p026.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m05_p027.name: m05_p027
eecs627:m05_p027.caption: Shorting body to gate gives low Vth when on and high Vth when off, but only works for Vdd < 0.6 V.
eecs627:m05_p027.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p003.name: m06_p003
eecs627:m06_p003.caption: A CMOS inverter driven by a step burns ½CV² in the switch on each transition; the capacitor itself stores energy without loss.
eecs627:m06_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p005.name: m06_p005
eecs627:m06_p005.caption: Ramping the input slowly over T cuts the loss to (RC/T)·CV², which goes to zero as T grows.
eecs627:m06_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p006.name: m06_p006
eecs627:m06_p006.caption: Ramping in n equal steps cuts the loss to ½CV²/n, which also goes to zero for large n.
eecs627:m06_p006.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p010.name: m06_p010
eecs627:m06_p010.caption: With an oscillating source, close the switch only when the voltage across it is zero, then ride the waveform up or down.
eecs627:m06_p010.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p020.name: m06_p020
eecs627:m06_p020.caption: An LC tank with a switch moves energy between inductor and capacitor every half cycle, which is lossless if Rswitch = 0.
eecs627:m06_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p021.name: m06_p021
eecs627:m06_p021.caption: Switch, wire and inductor resistance damp the oscillation, and the resonant frequency is fixed by L and C.
eecs627:m06_p021.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p022.name: m06_p022
eecs627:m06_p022.caption: Practical drivers kick the tank at its trough, at both peak and trough, or through a square-wave source into a large tank cap.
eecs627:m06_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p024.name: m06_p024
eecs627:m06_p024.caption: Single-rail adiabatic OR: pass transistors gate the power clock to the output, which tracks it minus a Vt drop.
eecs627:m06_p024.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p025.name: m06_p025
eecs627:m06_p025.caption: Adiabatic logic needs no clock gating and costs little energy, but needs a high-Q resonant clock and correct timing, and spends one clock phase per gate.
eecs627:m06_p025.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p032.name: m06_p032
eecs627:m06_p032.caption: A dual-rail inverter with cross-coupled PMOS gives full-rail outputs and a data-independent load, at the cost of 4 transistors and strict timing.
eecs627:m06_p032.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p036.name: m06_p036
eecs627:m06_p036.caption: Cascaded stages use power clocks 90 degrees apart, cycling input switch, evaluate, hold and precharge.
eecs627:m06_p036.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p037.name: m06_p037
eecs627:m06_p037.caption: Dual-rail adiabatic needs four 90-degree power clocks, evaluates one gate per phase, and cannot connect arbitrary outputs to inputs.
eecs627:m06_p037.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p039.name: m06_p039
eecs627:m06_p039.caption: PTERF is a dual-rail adiabatic inverter (power-clocked PMOS pair) feeding a NOR SR latch, bridging static logic to static logic.
eecs627:m06_p039.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p045.name: m06_p045
eecs627:m06_p045.caption: The output node discharges adiabatically to about Vthp and the remainder is lost non-adiabatically, hence partially adiabatic.
eecs627:m06_p045.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p048.name: m06_p048
eecs627:m06_p048.caption: AMD Piledriver (2012) used a resonant clock mesh, saving 24% of clock power and 10% of total.
eecs627:m06_p048.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m06_p049.name: m06_p049
eecs627:m06_p049.caption: SRAM charge recycling shorts bitlines at staggered voltages so charge is shared, claiming up to ~90% write power saving.
eecs627:m06_p049.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p003.name: m07_p003
eecs627:m07_p003.caption: At 0.18 µm, ~1000 dies spanned 30% in frequency and 20X in leakage, and the fastest dies were also the leakiest.
eecs627:m07_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p004.name: m07_p004
eecs627:m07_p004.caption: Performance variability (σ/µ) has grown node over node, with a dip at high-k metal gate and new rises with FinFET and EUV.
eecs627:m07_p004.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p009.name: m07_p009
eecs627:m07_p009.caption: Uncertainty enters at design (modeling and analysis), manufacturing (process), and application (context: V, T, workload, aging), and each stage is modeled differently.
eecs627:m07_p009.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p011.name: m07_p011
eecs627:m07_p011.caption: A 2D rule-table extractor underestimated coupling capacitance by about 4X and total capacitance by about 2X compared with a 3D field solver.
eecs627:m07_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p014.name: m07_p014
eecs627:m07_p014.caption: In planar devices the 3σ/µ budget was about 3% for Tox, 5–7% for L and 5% for RDF.
eecs627:m07_p014.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p015.name: m07_p015
eecs627:m07_p015.caption: In FinFETs RDF drops to 2% and Tox to 1.5%, but L grows to 8–12% and fin width (10–15%) and metal gate granularity (5–8%) appear.
eecs627:m07_p015.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p018.name: m07_p018
eecs627:m07_p018.caption: Soft copper dishes in wide lines and erodes in dense arrays, so metal thickness, and therefore R and C, depends on layout density.
eecs627:m07_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p020.name: m07_p020
eecs627:m07_p020.caption: Floating fill adds two series coupling caps with switching dependence, while grounded fill adds larger ground caps without it, and either must be modeled.
eecs627:m07_p020.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p024.name: m07_p024
eecs627:m07_p024.caption: Minimum feature size is k1·λ/NA, and since 193 nm light printed features far below its wavelength for two decades, everything rides on k1 (RET) and NA.
eecs627:m07_p024.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p027.name: m07_p027
eecs627:m07_p027.caption: Without OPC the printed gate length varies by about 20%, and OPC pre-distorts the mask with hammerheads and serifs to compensate.
eecs627:m07_p027.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p028.name: m07_p028
eecs627:m07_p028.caption: OPC adds serifs and sub-resolution scattering bars so the printed gate matches the drawn shape.
eecs627:m07_p028.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p030.name: m07_p030
eecs627:m07_p030.caption: A 180° phase shifter makes adjacent openings interfere destructively so two close features print separately instead of merging.
eecs627:m07_p030.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p034.name: m07_p034
eecs627:m07_p034.caption: Pitch-split DPL prints shapes in two exposures and needs tight overlay, while SADP uses spacers to double pitch and is immune to overlay but forces one CD.
eecs627:m07_p034.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p035.name: m07_p035
eecs627:m07_p035.caption: Features closer than the single-exposure spacing must go on different masks, some conflicts are fixed by stitches, but odd-cycle native conflicts cannot be fixed.
eecs627:m07_p035.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p036.name: m07_p036
eecs627:m07_p036.caption: Two masks give two gate-length populations, which breaks the assumption that neighbors are correlated and increases mismatch between adjacent devices.
eecs627:m07_p036.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p041.name: m07_p041
eecs627:m07_p041.caption: If the mask1 access transistor is stronger than the mask2 pull-up and pull-down on the same node, write gets easier but read stability gets worse.
eecs627:m07_p041.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p043.name: m07_p043
eecs627:m07_p043.caption: Each node added a resolution trick: OPC at 180 nm, phase shift and scattering bars at 90 nm, immersion at 45 nm, double patterning at 32/22 nm, quad patterning at 12/10 nm, and EUV at 7/5 nm.
eecs627:m07_p043.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p045.name: m07_p045
eecs627:m07_p045.caption: Fewer dopant atoms per channel means σVth/µVth grows as Na^−0.6, so lowering doping makes relative variation worse unless HKMG helps.
eecs627:m07_p045.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p047.name: m07_p047
eecs627:m07_p047.caption: Line edge roughness makes L vary along the gate width, so the device leaks like its shortest slice and Ion/Ioff degrades.
eecs627:m07_p047.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p051.name: m07_p051
eecs627:m07_p051.caption: Channel stress depends on source/drain length and contact placement, so two devices with the same W and L can differ by up to ~15% (PMOS).
eecs627:m07_p051.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p054.name: m07_p054
eecs627:m07_p054.caption: Local anneal temperature varies by more than 10 °C on 45 nm chips with layout pattern, and hotter anneal lowers Vth and Rext, raising both Ion and Ioff.
eecs627:m07_p054.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p061.name: m07_p061
eecs627:m07_p061.caption: Variation mechanisms change physical parameters, which change electrical parameters, which change circuit performance, and one physical parameter hits several electrical ones.
eecs627:m07_p061.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p063.name: m07_p063
eecs627:m07_p063.caption: Variation is systematic or random, random splits into die-to-die and within-die, and within-die splits into spatially correlated and uncorrelated, each with its own design fix.
eecs627:m07_p063.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p064.name: m07_p064
eecs627:m07_p064.caption: A 130 nm wafer CD map shows smooth spatial correlation across the wafer plus a repeating within-reticle signature.
eecs627:m07_p064.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p069.name: m07_p069
eecs627:m07_p069.caption: For a 2-gate path with dnom=100, σd2d=10 and σwid=5, a full corner gives 290 and zero mismatch, while local Monte Carlo at the global corner gives 281 and a 3σ mismatch of 21.
eecs627:m07_p069.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p071.name: m07_p071
eecs627:m07_p071.caption: Supply varies within the die through IR drop in the resistive grid and L·di/dt droop through package inductance.
eecs627:m07_p071.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p072.name: m07_p072
eecs627:m07_p072.caption: Activity creates temperature hot spots, with up to 30.3 °C rise on a processor, which shift speed and leakage locally.
eecs627:m07_p072.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p073.name: m07_p073
eecs627:m07_p073.caption: Broken Si–H bonds at the interface cause NBTI and hot-carrier degradation, broken Si–O bonds cause TDDB, and drive current drops within months.
eecs627:m07_p073.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p074.name: m07_p074
eecs627:m07_p074.caption: NBTI ΔVth and ΔIDS grow with stress time, and with scaling ΔVth in mV falls while the percentage Ion loss rises.
eecs627:m07_p074.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m07_p078.name: m07_p078
eecs627:m07_p078.caption: Electromigration fails where metal flux divergence occurs: more atoms in than out piles up into hillocks and shorts, and more out than in leaves voids and opens.
eecs627:m07_p078.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p002.name: m08_p002
eecs627:m08_p002.caption: DVFS adapts to workload, while AVFS adapts to process, voltage, temperature and aging, and many techniques do both at once.
eecs627:m08_p002.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p003.name: m08_p003
eecs627:m08_p003.caption: Variations range from extremely slow (process, aging, months) to slow (temperature, package VDD, seconds to ms) to fast (IR drop, jitter, coupling, ns), and slower ones are easier to address.
eecs627:m08_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p004.name: m08_p004
eecs627:m08_p004.caption: Static margins (process, aging), dynamic margins (V, T, noise) and safety margins (model uncertainty) stack on top of the point of first failure, costing power and closure effort.
eecs627:m08_p004.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p005.name: m08_p005
eecs627:m08_p005.caption: Summing 3σ delay impacts of eleven mechanisms gives 129% of delay, a very conservative and unrealistic guardband.
eecs627:m08_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p006.name: m08_p006
eecs627:m08_p006.caption: Variations sit on a grid of spatial reach (global vs local) and temporal rate (extremely slow, slow, fast), and each adaptive technique covers a different part of the grid.
eecs627:m08_p006.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p007.name: m08_p007
eecs627:m08_p007.caption: Low-power design fights robustness because low VDD raises Vt sensitivity and power optimization creates a wall of near-critical paths.
eecs627:m08_p007.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p010.name: m08_p010
eecs627:m08_p010.caption: To stay safe, always raise voltage before raising frequency and lower frequency before lowering voltage.
eecs627:m08_p010.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p011.name: m08_p011
eecs627:m08_p011.caption: Intel SpeedStep on XScale (0.18 µm) ran 800 MHz at 1.65 V and 900 mW down to 200 MHz at 0.75 V and 50 mW, switching frequency by slow PLL relocking.
eecs627:m08_p011.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p012.name: m08_p012
eecs627:m08_p012.caption: IBM DPM avoids slow PLL relocking by running the PLL at fixed frequency and selecting divided clocks with a glitch-free mux, with VDD scaled externally from 0.9 to 1.95 V.
eecs627:m08_p012.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p016.name: m08_p016
eecs627:m08_p016.caption: Design-time DVFS tables address none of the process, environmental or aging variations, because one table is used for every die.
eecs627:m08_p016.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p018.name: m08_p018
eecs627:m08_p018.caption: AVFS gives each die, and each moment of its life, its own operating point, and needs a sensor, a knob and an algorithm.
eecs627:m08_p018.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p022.name: m08_p022
eecs627:m08_p022.caption: Post-silicon tester tables address only variations fixed for the chip's lifetime, both global and local process.
eecs627:m08_p022.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p031.name: m08_p031
eecs627:m08_p031.caption: A critical path replica is launched every reference cycle, and if its output arrives before the reference-clock sample the counter steps VDD down, otherwise up, so VDD settles where the replica just meets fref.
eecs627:m08_p031.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p033.name: m08_p033
eecs627:m08_p033.caption: A tunable ring oscillator that tracks the critical path runs in a closed loop that adjusts the supply until the desired frequency is reached, saving 11% to 78% energy.
eecs627:m08_p033.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p035.name: m08_p035
eecs627:m08_p035.caption: TI SmartReflex (45 nm) combines adaptive body bias (FBB for speed, RBB for leakage), DVFS and AVS, with modes that cut power to well below baseline.
eecs627:m08_p035.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p039.name: m08_p039
eecs627:m08_p039.caption: A canary only tracks the real critical path across voltage approximately, and since the real critical path depends on the instruction, multiple canaries are needed to reduce the margin.
eecs627:m08_p039.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p040.name: m08_p040
eecs627:m08_p040.caption: IBM Power6 uses 24 critical-path monitors with a time-to-digital converter that reads timing slack as a thermometer code and models Fmax across voltage within 3 FO2 delays.
eecs627:m08_p040.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p041.name: m08_p041
eecs627:m08_p041.caption: Because the canary and the real critical path each vary locally, keeping tracking failures rare requires a 3σ margin on both distributions.
eecs627:m08_p041.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p043.name: m08_p043
eecs627:m08_p043.caption: The first supply droop after a load step is fast (under 10 cycles) and can be highly localized, so a remote canary cannot see or react to it in time.
eecs627:m08_p043.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p044.name: m08_p044
eecs627:m08_p044.caption: Itanium 2 regional voltage detectors spot a ~160 mV local droop and dither the regional clock from 2.272 GHz to 2.087 GHz for a droop lasting about 18 cycles.
eecs627:m08_p044.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p048.name: m08_p048
eecs627:m08_p048.caption: Canary response takes a detection delay plus a response delay, during which the core keeps slowing at the environment's rate of change, so the restore margin must cover that interval.
eecs627:m08_p048.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p050.name: m08_p050
eecs627:m08_p050.caption: Canary circuits address only variations that are not local or fast: D2D process, aging, package VDD and ambient temperature.
eecs627:m08_p050.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p054.name: m08_p054
eecs627:m08_p054.caption: Sampling the same data at three successively delayed clocks tells whether the path is too slow, tuned, too close, or failing, so frequency can be tuned on the real circuit.
eecs627:m08_p054.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p060.name: m08_p060
eecs627:m08_p060.caption: Razor I adds a shadow latch, clocked off the falling edge, to each critical flip-flop, and on a mismatch overwrites the main flop with the shadow latch's correct value.
eecs627:m08_p060.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p067.name: m08_p067
eecs627:m08_p067.caption: An error is detected when data arrives after the main flop's setup time but before the shadow latch closes, and the error must propagate through XOR and OR-tree within the detection window.
eecs627:m08_p067.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p069.name: m08_p069
eecs627:m08_p069.caption: Razor tunes voltage on error rate and purposely runs below the point of first failure, trading lower processor energy against rising recovery energy to find an optimal voltage.
eecs627:m08_p069.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p070.name: m08_p070
eecs627:m08_p070.caption: Measured: about 0.04% error rate and 0.2% IPC loss at the optimum, with about 5% extra energy reduction past the point of first failure.
eecs627:m08_p070.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p071.name: m08_p071
eecs627:m08_p071.caption: Razor II uses a single positive-level latch plus a transition detector on its internal node, flagging any transition after a short detection-clock pulse as a timing error and sending recovery to the pipeline.
eecs627:m08_p071.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p077.name: m08_p077
eecs627:m08_p077.caption: On chip TT9 at fixed 1 GHz, AVS lowered VDD to 0.97 V under a typical workload versus 1.1 V with 3% margin, saving 32% power, with a power virus pushing PoFF to 1.07 V.
eecs627:m08_p077.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m08_p083.name: m08_p083
eecs627:m08_p083.caption: Razor-based tuning addresses all variations on the grid, fast ones included, as long as they fit inside the detection window.
eecs627:m08_p083.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m09_p003.name: m09_p003
eecs627:m09_p003.caption: A MOSFET leaks through three paths, source-to-drain (subthreshold), gate (oxide tunneling) and junction (drain/source to body).
eecs627:m09_p003.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m09_p005.name: m09_p005
eecs627:m09_p005.caption: Below threshold the drain current is exponential in VGS − VTH, with a swing S = n(kT/q)ln10 of 60–100 mV/decade.
eecs627:m09_p005.provenance: Existing original slide image; exact source-caption match and within-page order verified

eecs627:m09_p006.name: m09_p006
eecs627:m09_p006.caption: In a short-channel device the drain field lowers the source barrier, so raising VDS lowers VT and raises Ioff sharply.
